structural_block: exact cached count_duration_only vectors: 14 summaries + 48 train-derived count basis columns
eeg_block: first 840 coordinates of cached real_trt or matched_gaussian; omit their old structural tails
structural_preprocessing: select on structural-only validation MRR, parameters fitted on training only; freeze and reuse identical transformed structural arrays across conditions
combined_search: same EEG imputer/scaler options, ridge alphas and post-scaling EEG weights; structural block weight fixed to 1
selection: validation MRR; ties within 1e-12 keep first entry; ascending weight is outer loop, preferring zero EEG on ties
zero_weight: exactly reuse the frozen-structural ridge path at each alpha; store zero EEG coefficients
test_policy: validation only; do not load raw MAT files, extract features or evaluate test data
